messages:
sam: FYI I'm running the conversion pipeline for model `open-7b-v3` into safetensors + TP shards. hit a couple of annoyances, wanted to surface for the onboarding checklist.

anya: thanks — can you paste the s3 path and the conv command?

sam: s3://rw-infer-models/incoming/open-7b-v3/raw/
conversion command I used:
```
python scripts/convert_hf_to_safetensors.py \
  --src_dir ./open-7b-v3 \
  --out_dir ./converted/safetensors_tp2_fp16 \
  --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --shard-prefix model_tp2_shard_\n```

sam: things I noticed: tokenizer.json has bos_token_id=1 but our serving tokenizer expects 0; also the safetensors shard naming is `model_tp2_shard_0.safetensors`..2, but loader expects `shard_00` style ordering.

miguel: that naming mismatch will break the loader indeed. We should standardize on 2-digit zero-pad for shard index. can you rename or add a symlink?

sam: I can add a quick renaming step in the pipeline. question though: is it better to change loader to be permissive or change converter to emit padded names?

iris: prefer converter change (single source of truth). loader being permissive hides upstream bugs.

anya: tokenizer mismatch — is it just bos vs pad? did you check special tokens mapping in `tokenizer_config.json`?

sam: tokenizer_config.json has `bos_token` set but no explicit `pad_token`. huggingface defaulted pad==eos (id 1). our serving path expects pad id 0 and uses `pad_token_id:0`. On-device generation tests failed with off-by-one logits.

miguel: quick patch: add `--pad-token 0 --pad-token-id 0` to the conversion call and inject a small mapping step to save updated tokenizer files. also add a unit test that tokenizes a short prompt and checks ids match expected.

convert-bot: Conversion job 1746212350 started. logs at https://ci.internal/runs/1746212350

sam: @miguel doing that now. also noticed fp16 -> safe conversion dropped some keys with dtype mismatch warning: "Unexpected int dtype in state_dict for key 'lm_head.weight'" — safetensors refused to write non-floating tensors.

miguel: that means there are int64 buffers (maybe index mappings) in the checkpoint. converter should cast floats to fp16 but leave int tensors as-is; safetensors supports ints but our cast step might be converting some small tensors incorrectly. can you paste the exact warning?

sam: warning: cast_to_dtype(fp16) skipped on key 'embed_positions' had dtype=int64, writing as int64; safetensors write succeeded but the loader later tried to cast everything to fp16 and crashed.

anya: we need a clear policy in the packaging README: which keys get cast, which are preserved. add a whitelist/blacklist.

chris: filing a quick PR to add pad-token injection + shard zero-padding + whitelist for non-float keys. pinging @sam for a small review. PR: https://git.internal/rw-infer/pkgs/conv/PR-482

sam: reviewed and left two comments. main one: please include a post-conversion validation that runs `scripts/check_model_serveable.py --model-dir ./converted/...` that checks: all shards present, tokenizer special tokens present, config.json `tp_dim` matches shard count, and a small generate smoke-test.

chris: good call, will add smoke test.

iris: also add a note for TP layout: HF sometimes uses interleaved TP layout vs contiguous. our runtime expects contiguous-per-rank layout. include a transformation `reorder_tp_layout.py` and a test vector file.

sam: added `reorder_tp_layout.py` locally. will push to PR after tests green.

convert-bot: Conversion job 1746212350 completed (SUCCESS). artifacts: s3://rw-infer-models/converted/open-7b-v3/safetensors_tp2_fp16/

tasha: quick question — for the config.json field names, are we using `tp` or `tensor_parallelism`? I saw both in older models.

miguel: canonical is `tensor_parallelism`: {"tp_degree": 2, "layout": "contiguous"}. we should normalize converters to emit that.

sam: checklist for landing this model into catalog (short):
- [ ] converter emits zero-padded shard names (shard_00.safetensors)
- [ ] tokenizer has explicit pad/bos/eos ids saved
- [ ] config.json uses `tensor_parallelism` with `tp_degree` and `layout`
- [ ] post-conversion `check_model_serveable.py` passes (shard count, layout, smoke gen)
- [ ] add unit tests for tokenizer id mapping and TP reorder script
- [ ] PR reviewed by @chris and @anya

chris: I'll merge once tests + smoke pass. please @mention me when PR updated. :thumbsup:

sam: will update PR now, ETA ~1h. leaving notes in PR about the fp16/int handling edge-case.

anya: awesome. thanks for the walkthrough — super helpful for future onboardings.

sam: one last note — if anyone wants to reproduce locally the full conversion run:
```
# env: conda activate rw-convert
python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=2 scripts/convert_hf_to_safetensors.py \
  --src_dir ./open-7b-v3 --out_dir ./converted --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --pad-token 0 --shard-prefix shard_\n```

sam: marking as in-progress on the model onboarding board. will update thread when merged.
